fact: Under H001, the fractions in D007 form a commutative subring R⊂ℚ containing ℤ. Thus the usual R-actions and inclusions R→ℚ→ℂ used here are legitimate, and integer numerators can act on J.
justification: The probed Nat.prime_iff_prime_int transfers H001 to primality of (p:ℤ). Unfolding the checked Prime definition gives the prime-divides-product implication, so p∤b and p∤d imply p∤bd. Also p∤1: a divisor of 1 is a unit, excluded by that definition. Fractions with admissible denominators are closed under addition and multiplication by using denominator bd≠0, and under negation by negating the numerator. Fractions 0/1, 1/1 and k/1 for every integer k are admissible. These elementary fraction calculations establish the subring guard and integer inclusion. This is routine validation of the displayed rational subring, not a localization or tensor exactness theorem.
